blurb: Caves Valley Golf Club is a private, member-owned club located near Baltimore, Maryland. It features an 18-hole golf course set in 962 acres of natural landscape, a state-of-the-art Performance Center with practice ranges and teaching staff, and dining and lodging facilities. The club hosts major golf tournaments and offers individual and group golf lessons.
